tools.name: vertodigital_search_site
tools.description:
Searches vertodigital.com and returns matching page links with one-line summaries as markdown, never page content (read a page with vertodigital_get_page).

tools.name: vertodigital_get_page
tools.description: Fetches one vertodigital.com page in full as clean markdown, without navigation or footer. Not a search: take the slug from vertodigital_search_site, or guess it, since an unknown slug returns an isError result with a hint. slug "contact" returns the contact page followed by a "Contact details" list

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vertodigital_search_site, vertodigital_get_page · Private data: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Public sink: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_send_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vertodigital_search_site, vertodigital_get_page · Private data: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Public sink: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_send_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
